note: Holidays, observances and seasonal moments people host around (server/inspiration.js). Each has a date rule, a lead window in days before the date (from, to), 2 or 3 hosting ideas, the create canvas kind, the cover drawing (public/eventart.js) and the regions it is shown in. type: civic, cultural, religious, season, watch. Religious observances never get party ideas (server/inspiration.js checkMoment). Dates from tables are the expected dates and can move a day with the calendar or moon sighting; the copy says 'around' for those.
